newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Group cuts dividend to $0.35/shr.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Group cuts dividend to $0.35/shr.

text.p: Horizon Group Inc said on Wednesday it has reduced its quarterly dividend 34 percent to $0.35 per share for the first quarter of 1997.
In the prior quarter, the company set a dividend of $0.53 per share.

Horizon said in a statement that it will "continue to review its dividends on a quarterly basis in light of results of operations, covenants in the company's revolving credit facilities and other factors."
The company said it "does not intend to make distributions in excess of adjusted funds from operations.

Horizon said it defines AFFO as net income before minority interest, excluding: gains or losses from real estate sales or debt restructuring, certain other one-time charges and write-downs, depreciation of real estate, and amortization other than the amortization of deferred financing cost.
